R objects of the YAML spec

Source: R/spec_yaml.R
tfl_r.Rd

The values a spec may hold that are not plain data, and the pieces a report is made of:

Usage

tfl_r(code)

tfl_unset()

tfl_call(fn, args = list(), package = NULL)

tfl_item(fn, args = list(), from = "own")

tfl_output(
  id,
  kind = c("table", "figure", "listing"),
  label = NA_character_,
  population = NA_character_,
  extends = "defaults",
  data = NULL,
  codelists = list(),
  content = list(),
  page = list(),
  ard = NULL
)

Arguments

code

One string of R code.

fn

A function's name (plan_cells, cards::ard_summary, rtf_border).

args

The arguments, a named list.

package

The package fn is in, when its name does not say.

from

Where an item came from: "own", "defaults", "pattern:<name>".

id

The report's id (letters, digits, ., _, -); the file is spec/outputs/<id>.yml.

kind

"table", "figure" or "listing".

label, population

The report's label and analysis set (NA: none).

extends

The files layered under this one, nearest first ("defaults", "patterns/<name>"); "none" for none.

data

What the report reads, its step 1 (a list: source – "ard", "code" or "dataset" – and object, steps, code, dataset ...).

codelists

The report's code lists, by variable.

content

The layers, a list of tfl_item.

page

The document: titles, footnotes, header, footer (maps by line), tokens, and the rtf_* calls' arguments.

ard

The report's part of the study ARD, made in the ARD stage before any report (a list: analysis_data, analyses); NULL none.

Value

tfl_r(): a string of class tfl_r; tfl_unset(): an object of class tfl_unset; the rest: lists of class tfl_call, tfl_item, tfl_output.

Details

  • tfl_r(): a string of R code, written as the !r tag (where: !r "p > 0.5"); kept as it is and put into the program unquoted.

  • tfl_unset(): the !unset tag – a value a report sets to nothing, overriding its defaults (writing nothing leaves the default). It is resolved when the defaults are layered; the generators never see one.

  • tfl_call(): a nested call ({fn: rtf_border, args: {top: single}}), for an argument that is itself a constructor's result.

  • tfl_item(): one layer of content: – a function (fn), its arguments by name (args), and where it came from (from: "own", "defaults" or "pattern:<name>").

  • tfl_output(): one report: id, kind, label, population, extends, data, codelists, content (a list of tfl_item) and page.

Examples

it <- tfl_item("plan_cells", list(continuous = list(n = "{N}")))
out <- tfl_output("T-1", "table", content = list(it))
out$content[[1]]$fn
#> [1] "plan_cells"
